instruction: I have five images available: pic1.png, pic2.png, pic3.png, pic4.png, and pic5.png on the Desktop. Please prepare a presentation with five blank slides, adding the images sequentially—pic1.png on the first slide through pic5.png on the fifth slide. Each slide should be clean with only the image present.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating 5 blank slides and inserting pic1.png through pic5.png sequentially. Expected: 5 slides total, each with exactly 1 image. Similar complexity to original with one less slide.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical verification gap: Evaluator only counts images per slide but cannot verify which specific image is on which slide
Instruction explicitly requires 'sequential' placement: pic1.png on slide 1, pic2.png on slide 2, etc., but evaluator cannot verify this requirement
Current evaluator would pass if images are in wrong order (e.g., pic5.png on slide 1, pic4.png on slide 2)
Current evaluator would pass if same image is duplicated across all slides (e.g., pic1.png on all 5 slides)
Getter only checks shape_type==13 (PICTURE) but doesn't extract image filename, content hash, or any image identity information
Partial credit: Evaluator correctly verifies slide count (5 slides) and image count per slide (1 image each), which are necessary but not sufficient conditions
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify getter to extract image metadata: For each image shape, extract the image filename or embedded image relationship ID from the PPTX structure
Expected values should specify which image appears on which slide: e.g., images_per_slide=[{count:1, name:'pic1.png'}, {count:1, name:'pic2.png'}, ...]
Metric should compare both image count AND image identity per slide to verify correct sequential placement
Alternative approach: Extract image binary data/hash and compare against known hashes of pic1.png through pic5.png to verify correct images are used
